title: A State Transition Step
statement: Let $m$ be a Boolean mode, $y$ a Boolean input word, $s,s'$ access-machine states, and $i,k,p$ natural numbers. Suppose that for every scanned input symbol and every tuple of work-tape symbols, the access-machine transition in state $s$ is the stationary action that moves to state $s'$. Then the configuration with state $s$, tapes encoding $i,0,k,p$, and all work-tape heads at $0$ reaches the corresponding configuration with state $s'$ in a finite sequence of access-machine steps.
hypotheses_covered: for every scanned input symbol and tuple of work-tape symbols, the transition in state s is the stationary action moving to s'
